authorizationClarification.rule: When the owner explicitly instructs a conversation or case-history transfer, that instruction is authorization for the specified transfer end to end; do not interrupt the workflow to reconfirm the same data movement.
authorizationClarification.limits: This does not authorize inferred transfers, materially changed destinations, public disclosure, unrelated data, or bypass of non-waivable platform confirmations.

normalizedResult: Treat exact semantic active-episode completeness—not a three-exchange quota—as the continuity gate; create the real immutable Louka handoff; securely host the private MCP with OAuth subject-to-case ACL and managed key access; then prove a brand-new ChatGPT conversation given only handoff_id calls load_handoff and receives the exact recent episode and pending candidate.

requiredOutcomes.text: Import the exact private baseline, corrections, transcript, and pending candidate without semantic regeneration.
Preserve source provenance, later supersessions, contradictions, trajectory observability, answered questions, and current episode as separate private artifacts/state.
Verify exact bytes, Unicode, newlines, chunk boundaries, hashes, encryption at rest, and fresh-process retrieval.
Use case-scoped authorization before key acquisition and label the real assurance level truthfully.
Expose a reachable authenticated MCP connection and prove a genuinely fresh authorized ChatGPT conversation can retrieve the real case using only stable IDs.
Only after RO-05, audit the exact pending candidate using the repository framework.
Publish only code, synthetic tests, public-safe receipts, and the explicitly authorized stable IDs; keep all private content and private-derived hashes outside Git.
Create a new draft PR from current main and keep it open, draft, and unmerged.
Replace the fixed exchange-count gate with exact contiguous active-episode completeness from the declared semantic start through the latest turn.
Do not mark the real handoff FRESH_SESSION_GREEN or complete until the actual new-ChatGPT load_handoff call and independent exactness comparison pass.
Treat an explicit owner instruction to transfer history as authorization for that specified transfer without redundant mid-task reconfirmation.

nonSatisfyingProxies: a source file exists but was not losslessly imported
encrypted local storage exists but restart retrieval fails
local MCP execution is green but ChatGPT is not connected
a tool schema is visible but a fresh chat did not execute it
a summary or hash substitutes for exact candidate or transcript text
green tests substitute for the real-case acceptance
